subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Showing or having skill, especially with the hands.
solution: The correct answer is **"Dexterous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Dexterous"** means showing or having skill, especially with the hands. (विशेष रूप से हाथों से कौशल दिखाना या होना) • **Example**: *The chef's **dexterous**__ hands were able to create a beautiful and delicious meal.* • It is derived from the Latin word **"dexter"**, which means **"right" or "skillful."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Insomniac**, means a person who has difficulty sleeping. (अनिद्रा का रोगी) • **Option 2, Meticulous**, means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (ब्‍योरों पर बहुत ध्‍यान देने वाला या ब्‍योरों को बहुत ध्यान से दिखाने वाला; बहुत सतर्क, अति सावधान) • **Option 3, Pertinent**, means relevant or applicable to a particular matter; apposite. (चर्चाधीन विषय से गहरे संबंधित; संगत, प्रासंगिक) 38:T63f, Here, the erroneous part is** "did you took a break."**
